sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Escape from Tarkov features four skill categories trained through active use. In short, the more you use a skill, the better you get at it.

sections.heading: Leveling
sections.text:
- A skills maximum level is 51 (Elite level). However, a skill can temporarily surpass this limit with status effects from certain Stimulants and Provisions.
  - Most skills provide unique perks at the Elite level.
  - Temporary status effects can never bring a skill past level 60.
- The number of skill points to reach level 1 is 10. Afterwards, it increases by 10 per level and is capped at 100 per skill level.
- Some Quests award skill levels as a reward.
  - Sometimes it is worthwhile to avoid completing a quest until a skill is at least level 9 to ensure the quest rewards the maximum number of points possible.

sections.heading: Leveling speed
sections.text:
- Each skill has its own leveling speed modifier depending on how many skill points have recently been earned in the raid:
  - 129%: Before the first skill point.
  - 100%: After the first skill point.
  - 45%: After 4 skill points.
  - 20%: After 5 skill points.
  - 9%: After 6 skill points.
  - 4%: After 7 skill points.
  - 1%: After 8 skill points.
- After not earning any skill points for 200 seconds, the modifier is reset to 100% for that skill.
- The base leveling speed is significantly increased in the Seasonal mode and may be further increased or decreased by personal modifiers.

sections.heading: Hideout modifiers
sections.text:
- Upgrading the Hideout module "Shooting Range" to level 3 grants a 10% leveling boost to the Combat skills group.
- Building the Hideout module "Library" grants a 30% leveling boost to the Practical skills group.
- Building the Hideout module "Air Filtering Unit" grants a 40% leveling boost to the Physical skills group.
  - The boost is only provided with an inserted FP-100 filter absorber.
- Building the Hideout module "Hall of Fame" grants a leveling boost to the Combat skills group.
  - The boost value depends on the amount and levels of stored opposing faction Dogtags.
- The levels 2-5 of the Hideout module "Defective Wall" each cause a 3% leveling penalty (12% total) to the Physical skills group.
  - The penalty can be reduced by "mopping the floor" with a Fleece fabric, but in order to get rid of the penalty entirely, the module has to be upgraded to level 6.

sections.heading: Planned skills
sections.text: These skills are no longer visible in the game and most likely cut.
